instruction: Identify potential compliance concerns based strictly on verified regulatory text.
context: CERT-In Directions under Section 70B(6): Body corporate must report cyber incidents within 6 hours.
document: Security Policy: In the event of an incident, notification will be sent within 48 business hours.

output.finding: Observed 48-hour notification timeline does not align with the statutory 6-hour CERT-In reporting requirement.
output.evidence: notification will be sent within 48 business hours
output.requirement: Body corporate must report cyber incidents within 6 hours of noticing.
output.action: Update incident reporting policy to mandate CERT-In reporting within 6 hours.
